create-instance.import-hint: Pick a modpack file (.mrpack / .zip). The game version and loader come from its manifest; the import runs in the background — watch it in Downloads.
create-instance.import-partial: Imported, but {p1} file(s) could not be downloaded — check the instance content page
instance-settings.export-desc: Pack this instance into a .mrpack to share. Registered mods / resource packs / shaders are stored as download links only, so the archive stays small.
instance-settings.export-done: Created {p1} and opened the share sheet
instance-detail.shared-hint: The game itself and Java live outside this instance folder (shared by all instances), so the Files tab only shows this instance's own config and worlds.
instances.cleanup-msg: The {p2} files used by this instance take {p1} and no other instance needs them. Delete them as well? (You'll have to download them again later.)
multiplayer.mohua-frp-desc: Port forwarding: expose a local port publicly — only the host runs the client, guests connect with vanilla Minecraft
multiplayer.rooms-desc: XTCP rooms: host opens a room, guests join — both sides run the client (no exposed port)
rooms.title: XTCP rooms
rooms.desc: Host–visitor mode: both sides run frpc. After the host starts the room, others tap "Join & connect" and connect to the shown 127.0.0.1:<port> in-game.
rooms.empty: No rooms yet — create one and others will see it in the list
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.pending: Room is under review — others can't find it yet
rooms.connect-hint: Connect to {p1} in-game (local port forwarded by frpc)
frp.site-unknown: Website address not loaded yet (go back to this page to refresh)
frp.login-desc: Sign in with a device code — confirm in your browser, no password typing on the phone.
frp.login-step1: Open the authorization page in your browser and confirm this code:
frp.login-waiting: Waiting for you to confirm in the browser…
frp.login-timeout: Authorization timed out, please try again
frp.tunnels-empty: No tunnels on this account yet — create one on the panel website, then refresh here
settings.key-layout-desc: Open the native landscape editor to adjust keys, size and position (same UI as in-game, WYSIWYG)
plugins.external-opened: This plugin isn't hosted on Hangar — opened the download page in your browser; drop the jar into the server's plugins folder afterwards
plugins.no-download: This plugin has no downloadable file (the API returned no download URL)
install-dialog.no-server-yet: No server yet — create one under More → Multiplayer
install-dialog.plugin-hint: Plugins go into the server's plugins folder; a build matching that server's MC version is picked automatically
install-dialog.plugin-compat-unknown: This plugin does not declare supported MC versions — it may not work
server-detail.plugins-hint: Search PaperMC's plugin platform (Hangar). A build matching this server's MC version is picked automatically and dropped into the plugins folder.
server-detail.plugins-compat-unknown: This plugin does not declare supported MC versions — it may not work
server-detail.plugins-delete-confirm: Delete {p1}? The server will stop loading it on next start.
